overall: The AG declined the May 18, 2011 allegations as untimely filed and found the May 25, 2011 executive session minutes substantially complied with the Open Meeting Law. No violation was found and the matter was closed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 18, 2011 executive session discussion was held 'off the record' and asked that the May 18 and May 25 minutes be amended. The complaint was filed late.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to investigate the allegations related to the May 18, 2011 meeting because it was not timely filed with the Board.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 25, 2011 minutes, including the executive session minutes, omitted the discussion of the May 18 minutes and were too thin for a 15-minute discussion.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board's May 25, 2011 executive session minutes substantially complied with the requirement that it provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion that occurred.
